messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated gateway 502/504 rate observed in prod-us-east-1 (18% 5xx over last 3m). Triggering page to primary oncall @anya. Metrics: https://metrics.redwood.example/d/edge?panel=502_rate

anya (oncall): Acked — I'm on it. Any initial customer impact notes?

matt (eng-sre): Seeing a spike of timeouts and a bunch of `upstream prematurely closed connection` in edge logs. Traces are sparse for the window - many requests missing span ids, looks like headers aren't being propagated upstream.

linh (eng-runtime): Confirmed in a quick sample: ingress is not forwarding `X-Request-Id` for ~10:15–10:22 window. Log rotation and a config reload happened shortly before spike. We don't have good traces because span headers are being dropped. Suggest temporary shim to inject synthetic req id and enable verbose upstream headers.

jamal (support): Multiple customers reported UI 502s, ~30-40% failures for some tenants during the window. CS has a few debug captures. Sample curl from affected tenant: `curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>'` -> 502.

olivia (eng-infra): I can push a hotpatch to the edge-proxy config to (A) enable upstream header passthrough logging and (B) insert a log-shim that emits `req_id` if missing. Plan: canary 10% -> monitor -> 100%. Patch command I will run:```bash
kubectl -n ingress rollout restart deploy/edge-proxy-canary
kubectl -n ingress patch configmap edge-proxy-cfg --patch '"data": {"enable_upstream_headers": "true", "log_shim_insert_reqid": "true"}'
```

anya (oncall): Do the canary. Also add a structured log line when reqid missing like `req_id=missing host=$host upstream=$upstream` so we can grep quickly. Opening live debug bridge now.

incident-bot: Deploy started by olivia: edge-proxy hotpatch (canary 10%). CI/CD job: https://ci.redwood.example/job/edge-hotpatch/1234

matt (eng-sre): Please also enable temporary trace sampling at 100% for the gateway to capture spans for the next ~2 minutes:```bash
kubectl -n tracing set env deployment/gateway TRACE_SAMPLE_RATE=1.0
```

linh (eng-runtime): Sampling enabled. I pushed a quick Loki query and a Jaeger span filter to surface requests that lack `X-Request-Id`. Early look: a subset of failures show `connection reset by peer` to kv-cache hosts — backend pool exhaustion looks plausible. Not yet certain if proxy or backend is root cause.

jamal (support): Customer-impact note: two enterprise tenants in eu-west reported higher error surfaces; CS posted temporary UX workaround (retry once after 100ms). Customers notified of ongoing investigation.

olivia (eng-infra): Canary looks good at 10% — logs now include `req_id=missing` lines and upstream header details. Rolling to 100% now. Patch diff: changed `proxy.buffer_size` + added `log_shim_insert_reqid=true`.

anya (oncall): Rolling. Observing metrics — error rate dropping from 18% -> 6% in first 3m after rollout. Keeping page open and watching for any regression.

incident-bot: Update: edge-proxy hotpatch rolled to 100% by olivia. Telemetry link: https://metrics.redwood.example/d/edge?panel=502_rate&from=now-6m

matt (eng-sre): With shim in place we can now join logs -> spans. Preliminary trace join shows repeated `504` from kv-cache pool with `reset` errors around connection reuse. Opening a backend investigation ticket.

linh (eng-runtime): Created follow-up ticket ENG-OBS-457 (missing upstream header propagation and kv-cache connection hardening). Assigning to eng-runtime for RCA. Also added a short-term kcache pool size increase on one cluster to see impact.

anya (oncall): Impact update: error rate now ~3% and trending down. Will keep monitoring for 30m then handoff to next oncall. Thanks for the quick patch.

olivia (eng-infra): Note — canary diff included a buffer tuning change; if we don't need it for RCA we should revert that to minimize side effects. I'll open a PR for the hotpatch rollback plan and the permanent fix that ensures header passthrough.

anya (oncall): Handoff: I'll hand this to morning oncall @sanjay in 30m for follow-up and RCA tracking. Sanjay please take ENG-OBS-457.

sanjay (oncall-next): Ack — I'll pick it up and coordinate with eng-runtime + infra in morning.

jamal (support): CS update: customers notified of mitigation and workaround. Will follow up with ETA for full RCA once ENG-OBS-457 has initial triage.

anya (oncall): Thanks team :thumbsup: Closing live mitigation thread, leaving monitoring open. I'll write the incident summary and link ENG-OBS-457. Follow-ups: add permanent header-propagation test in e2e, improve trace sampling alerts, and review proxy reload procedures to avoid header-drop windows.
